title: Report of one run, as H0 accepts it from the exercise channel (H-1)
description: The report of one run, an attack or a fault: annatar/runner/report.py and gothmog/runner/report.py write it, from the class both share (eregion_core/run_report.py, C1). The campaign report reads its run id and its attack time; the console's coverage matrix reads it whole (eregion_console/coverage.py). Other fields are allowed. Its run_id must also be the run's own (checked by analysis/campaign_schema.py, which runs on H0). A run --without-glorfindel (V1) says so in without_glorfindel, and then carries no detection verdict. Since C1 a report says what it is (run_format, kind, injector, experiment_id; resource_id for an attack): all optional, a report written before reads as before.

kind.description: C1: an attack or a fault

experiment_id.description: C1: the technique's ATT&CK id, or the fault's id, as the catalog names it

resource_id.description: C1: an attack's target VM, where the watch's decision is attached
